name: memory_trial_model_v206
purpose: First bounded implementation/test of V2 representation hypotheses, cross-episode time scales, and exact finite-budget real-trial decisions. Not a rerun of V205 or a trained-RL superiority study.
candidate_selectors: constant, current fields, every declared past ordinal/field; recent2 instead exposes last two events; no hidden relevant-slot or target input
prediction_prior: Beta(1,1) pseudocount per expert/context/action, an explicit prediction prior, not a calibrated posterior after fractional forgetting
expert_loss: pre-observation squared error on the actually observed binary factual outcome
trial_budget_model: Exact memoized V2 exploration-then-commit recurrence. All trial and deployment episodes consume the same remaining budget. No adoption without an actual pair. Frozen compared policies; fresh integer counts for each pair identity/cycle.
initial_incumbent: first legal action; all variants receive equal actual discovery and normal subsequent factual learning
noise: same context within a pair, independent arm outcome streams; matched stream names across variants; evaluation excluded from learning
accounting: shared actual discovery counted once externally and once per learner exposure; deployment evaluation selects its already-fixed role from an independent actual two-role bank without new duplicate rollouts
selection_schedule: after discovery create a candidate; do actual comparison/commit/deployment within the same budget; ingest active records in chronological order for the next candidate; no within-batch policy mutation
scope_limits: Binary factual module, finite unary representation family; not V205 multi-step additive planning, arbitrary semantics, causal identification, or SLEEP parameter consolidation. Cost .02 is an explicit uncalibrated utility proxy; report gross return and interaction counts too.
